Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

A married couple, a husband and a wife, just started couples counselling after a mutual friend recommended they try it. The friend had seen some bruises on the husband's arms and so asked what happened, only to learn that it was the wife who was responsible. Who physically abuses their spouse?
A. The husband
B. Cannot be determined
C. The wife
